objective: Test whether completed Deribit BTC/ETH 30-day implied-volatility common and relative states causally route four-asset Binance USD-M factor-neutral residuals into cost-robust continuation or reversion with broad trade distribution.
economic_hypothesis: DVOL is a 30-day forward-looking volatility state rather than a directional label. A high positive implied-versus-realized volatility premium should identify option-priced uncertainty in which unsupported idiosyncratic residuals are more likely to normalize. A low or negative premium, a common implied-volatility shock, or an extreme ETH-versus-BTC implied-volatility spread should identify underpriced or asset-group-specific information transmission in which flow-confirmed factor-neutral residuals are more likely to continue. The new information source is the causal options-implied state; it is not an adjacent threshold retune of the reported dynamic-factor family or a repetition of direct DVOL directional shocks.

non_overlap.material_change: Adds completed Deribit BTC/ETH implied-volatility common, relative and implied-versus-realized state to a four-asset factor-neutral router.

dvol.availability: A DVOL candle with open_time t becomes usable only at t+1h.

market.source: Binance Vision official USD-M monthly archives retained in binance-usdm-research-data-20260723.zip

data.conditional_2024: Only development representatives passing every gate may open 2023. 2024 stays sealed unless the same frozen representative also passes 2023.

causal_features.factor: At each completed 5m bar, each target uses the median contemporaneous return of the other three completed bars.
causal_features.rolling_beta: Prior-only rolling covariance/variance; the current bar is excluded.
causal_features.residual: Target cumulative completed-bar return minus prior beta times the cumulative leave-one-out factor return.
causal_features.residual_z: Standardized against prior completed residual history only.
causal_features.flow_z: Target signed taker-quote flow over the same horizon, standardized on prior completed history only.
causal_features.dvol_common: Mean of completed BTC and ETH DVOL levels.
causal_features.dvol_relative: log(ETH_DVOL/BTC_DVOL), standardized on prior completed hourly values.
causal_features.common_vrp: Completed common DVOL minus prior 30-day annualized realized volatility of BTC and ETH, standardized on prior completed hourly observations.
causal_features.dispersion: Cross-sectional standard deviation of factor-neutral residual z-scores, standardized on prior completed history.
causal_features.prefix_invariance: All development features and signals must be identical when later rows are removed.

families.HIGH_VRP_RESIDUAL_FADE: When common VRP is high, fade the largest extreme residual whose target flow is weak or opposite.
families.LOW_VRP_RESIDUAL_CONTINUATION: When common VRP is low/negative, follow the largest extreme residual whose target flow confirms.
families.RELATIVE_IV_GROUP_CONTINUATION: When ETH-versus-BTC implied volatility is extreme, follow a flow-confirmed residual in the higher-implied-volatility group: ETH/SOL/XRP for positive relative IV, BTC for negative relative IV.
families.RELATIVE_IV_DISCONFIRMATION_FADE: In the same higher-implied-volatility group, fade an extreme residual not supported by target flow.
families.IV_SHOCK_DISPERSION_CONTINUATION: After a common DVOL shock and factor-neutral dispersion expansion, follow the strongest flow-confirmed residual.

execution.signal: completed 5m bar with the latest already-completed DVOL state
execution.same_timestamp_tie_break: highest preregistered score, then BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP
execution.stop: signal-bar prior ATR multiple from actual entry; entry-bar and gap stops included; stop first on same-bar ambiguity
execution.state_exit_fades: after at least 3 bars, exit at next open when absolute residual z <= 0.5 or position-aligned flow z < 0
execution.state_exit_continuations: after at least 3 bars, exit at next open when position-aligned residual z <= 0.5 or position-aligned flow z < 0
execution.funding: Actual funding settlements in (entry, exit], valued at exact mark-price open when available and exact contract open only as a documented fallback.

selection_gate: The identical frozen candidate and execution path must pass the same gate on 2023 before 2024 may be opened.
prohibitions: No target-return, leverage or risk fitting.
No 2023 access before the development screen and representative manifest are frozen.
No 2024 access before a frozen candidate passes 2023.
No parameter change after seeing selection results.
No paper, testnet or live orders.
